item.title: Version 1.4.5
item.description:
v1.4.5

  • Win11 notification bell now tracks the Notification Center list: clearing notifications in the top-right panel zeros the badge.
  • Notification Center is polled every 2 seconds while closed, and every 0.4 seconds only while the panel is open or was just cleared.
⚠️ Accessibility Permission

Builds use a stable code signature. If merge-windows / title display stop working after this update: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility → select RetroWin → −, relaunch, and Allow again. Later updates with the same signature should keep the grant.
